R2B-04.implementation: Reject unregistered assignment before mutation; preserve disconnected workers' completed deferred reports rather than refreshing them; resume a ready simulated-time round from disconnect when there is no subsequent completion event. Existing outstanding live urgency still delays aggregation.
R2B-04.construction: ServerEvents client_alive starts actual production selection. Two physical workers/max_concurrency=2, four logical clients per round, minimum_clients=1, staleness_bound=1, request_update=true, debug=false. Actual report/chunk/part/done handlers produce rounds 7/2/8/9 then 9 and 9; the default urgency predicate requests lost/7 and survivor/2, deferring lost/8. Normal sends queue completions for later events rather than completing inside _send.
R2B-04.matrix: Both disconnect/completion orders x no lost transfer, report-only, partial chunk and decoded part = 8 recovery cases per interpreter; both orders x missing/true debug = 4 close-policy cases.
R2B-04.positive_result: All eight recovery cases on each interpreter preserve client 8's original completed payload and bytes, clear lost active/cache state, aggregate round-3 payloads {2:2,9:9,8:8}, finish a full [7,2,8,9] batch entirely on survivor, finish the next replacement and reach round 6. Only the original two urgent requests are emitted; all subsequent assignments belong to registered survivor.
R2B-04.accounting_and_identity: An independent oracle sums recorded raw report/chunk lengths for unique report objects retained by heap/cache/active transfers after every event. Initial retained bytes=380, final usable retained bytes=570, close=0. Deferred token/payload survive until aggregation; heap stays valid and time never decreases. Late lost identities 7/8, prior survivor identity 2, deferred identity 8 and unknown session reject with a fail-on-parse sentinel before parsing.
R2B-04.negative_reference: Exact previous 7753ca37 source gives 11 failed/6 passed on each interpreter: 8 new recovery failures plus 3 shipped assignment/order failures, with 6 existing close-policy cases passing. Lost-first reaches a dead lost/8 emit; survivor-first remains at round 3. No red candidate mutation was performed.
R2B-04.stubs_and_limit: Outbound transport is an event queue; payload/report generation is inert; aggregation records updates and yields, wrap_up records no model work, and close calls actual _close_connections. Selection, registration, batching, urgency, assignment, ingress, disconnect, heap, cleanup and round transitions are production code. No urgent trainer snapshot decoder/checkpoint retrieval or real urgent socket training claim.
